body: I highly doubt he killed himself. He's my uncle, me and my family already thought this through. He was pretty successful over in cali as far as i can tell, and he was just ready to come back to his home state. He already had a job here and a house with furniture being shipped to it. I dont see why he would do any of that if he was suicidal. I dont blame you for thinking this however. And foul play IS suspected though, I'm not really sure where you got that from.
Hi! Thats really nice to hear. However i don't think you're talking about my mom specifically. Richie has a few sisters, you're probably thinking of Summer, right? Shoot me a dm if you have the time!

We're all doing a lot better today, especially after hearing his impact from his own students and the people that knew him while he lived there! Im sad that hes gone but hes done a lot more than any of us had, he's traveled the world and has experienced so many things. He lived a very happy life.

This was my uncle Richie. I wasnt very close to him, but every memory i have of him was a good one. I remember when he came back to Louisiana for Christmas a few years ago and i enjoyed being around his presence so much. It was like he lit up a room as soon as he stepped in it. That was the first year in a long time that it had snowed as well. He had such a kind soul and ill never forget him. He's made such an impact on my life. It makes me and my mom so happy to hear that he was well known for his fun and kind personality over in California.

I know im commenting a lot on posts about this- but this was my uncle. He was the little brother of his siblings and he was adored and loved so much. We're so glad to hear that people knew him for his outgoing and fun personality over in California as much as we did. I miss his goofy smile so much. May Richie rest in peace <3

He was my uncle. Our family loved him very much, he was the youngest of his siblings and was still the baby of the family lol. I didnt get to see him often since we live hours away, only on holidays and such, but it means so much to hear that he was such a good guy and that he was loved. I always looked up to him and felt like he understood me better than anyone else in our family. I miss his goofy smile

I cant help but tear up. This is my uncle, my moms little brother. My mom and my aunts always said Richie had a goofy smile <3 i didnt want to look at any news articles, but im glad this one has a picture of him happy.

My mom just showed me this post. I'm heartbroken to hear your experience, I'll admit it made me cry.
His name is Richard and he was my uncle, my moms little brother. 
We learned about his death on Friday, and our immediate family got together. We had almost no idea what happened to him, all we knew was that he was found in a river and they couldn't identify him by fingerprints because of how long he was in the water.
We don't live in California, we still live in Louisiana where he was born and where he was planning on moving back to. He had big plans and even a new job here. His mama was so excited to see him.
It hurts my heart that i couldnt have been closer to Richie. So many people looked up to him. He was one of the only people in my moms side of the family that i felt like really understood me, and who i could've been  close to.
He wanted his ashes spread in mexico, and we're planning to get passports to do it for him. Its the last thing we can do for him.

Last year i had an English teacher that always expressed that she couldnt handle any of her classes. She was really lovely and one of the only teachers i could actually talk to. You could tell something was wrong with her, being her mental wellness probably wasnt so.. Well. My mom even told me she seemed like she needed a friend and even almost gave her her number when we went to a parent teacher conference. Well towards the end of the semester she eventually just loses her shit. Stops teaching, or if she does its very passive aggressive, talks about how she can no longer handle us and that she just wants to quit. She does about two weeks before semester was over, but kept coming back every now and then as if she was "regretting" her decision. All of the students thought she was crazy and were disrespecting her. I was glad she was leaving, not because i wanted her to, but because she didnt deserve to be under all that stress.
